_doc: AI key -> answer on the pessimistic Plus profile over LTE, scripted hub with ~1.4 s time to first token. Targets are design goals (foundation 4.5, 6.4).

ai.answers.why: the two asks without an outage must complete (text and speech)

ai.failures.why: the ask during the outage must fail visibly, not hang

ai.press_to_listening_visible_ms.p95.why: AI key -> listening prompt visible; SR-UX-05/01a will be met by the audio prompt (tone), the screen alone cannot do 300 ms; 700 since D-107: the larger text makes the panel 16% taller and PQ-BN draws it in proportion

ai.release_to_first_text_visible_ms.p95.why: release -> first answer text visible (scripted hub thinks 1.4 s)

ai.release_to_error_visible_ms.max.why: a lost answer must be reported within seconds (dead connection detection)

mem.internal_total.min_free_bytes.why: SR-PL-04: at least 32 KiB of internal RAM (internal heap + DMA reserve, both usable by internal-only allocations) left at the worst moment

mem.dma.min_free_bytes.why: DMA reserve headroom for users not modelled yet (Wi-Fi RX bursts) after display bounce, 4G UART NIC and SD bounce buffers

mem.internal_total.largest_free_min_byte.why: an internal-only allocation of 8 KiB (task stack, TLS record buffer) must still succeed at the worst moment

warnings.count.why: a simulator warning (stack, long burst, unknown cost class, underrun ...) means the run is not clean

ai.press_to_tone_heard_ms.p95.why: AI key -> listening tone heard: the perceivable acknowledgement (the panel needs ~0.5 s)

ai.release_to_first_audio_heard_ms.p95.why: release -> first syllable of the spoken answer heard (scripted hub: stt 0.3 s + think 1.4 s + TTS 0.5 s)

audio.mic.lost_ms.why: no microphone audio may be lost (flash writes are held off, the capture ring rides out refreshes)

audio.speaker.underruns.why: no audible gap in the spoken answer, page turns and refreshes included

audio.jitter_overflow.why: the jitter buffer must hold what a faster-than-real-time TTS stream sends ahead
